title.narrative: Fighting corruption through civil society action

description.narrative: 'Consortium of core funding (organisational strategies, results frameworks and organisational budgets) for TI-S (consortium lead) and two other NGO partners.The development objective of the development cooperation among the parties is to accelerate impact in the global fight against corruption by combining the strengths of civil society advocacy, investigative journalism and coalition building. Value of the contract is 18,000,000 DKK.

participating-org.narrative: Denmark - Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Danida

recipient-country.narrative: This is a global project and is managed by TI-S which is headquartered in Germany.
